title: Single-Phase RL Source-Load Real-Time HIL Benchmark
description: Minimal 50-microsecond RTDS RSCAD draft circuit modeling a 138 kV sinusoidal voltage source energizing a series RL feeder and resistive load for real-time HIL verification.
code:
CASE SinglePhase_RL_HIL
TIME_STEP 50e-6
FINISH_TIME 0.10
FREQUENCY 60
SUBSYSTEM 1
COMPONENT SOURCE SRC_138 nodes=BUS_SRC,0 V=112676
COMPONENT R R_SRC nodes=BUS_SRC,BUS_LINE R=1.2
COMPONENT L L_LINE nodes=BUS_LINE,BUS_LOAD L=0.025
COMPONENT R R_LOAD nodes=BUS_LOAD,0 R=85.0

title: Three-Phase 230 kV Transmission Line Fault Injection
description: Two-terminal 230 kV transmission corridor modeled in RTDS RSCAD with pi-section line inductance, shunt capacitance, and mid-span fault branch for distance relay HIL testing.
code:
CASE Line230kV_Fault_HIL
TIME_STEP 50e-6
FINISH_TIME 0.25
FREQUENCY 60
SUBSYSTEM 1
COMPONENT SOURCE SRC_WEST nodes=WEST_BUS,0 V=187794
COMPONENT SOURCE SRC_EAST nodes=EAST_BUS,0 V=187794
COMPONENT R R_LINE1 nodes=WEST_BUS,MID_FAULT R=2.4
COMPONENT L L_LINE1 nodes=MID_FAULT,MID_NODE L=0.032
COMPONENT C C_MID nodes=MID_NODE,0 C=2.2e-6
COMPONENT R R_LINE2 nodes=MID_NODE,EAST_BUS R=2.4
COMPONENT R R_FAULT nodes=MID_FAULT,0 R=5.0

title: Synchronous Machine Excitation & Step-Up Transformer HIL
description: Real-time RTDS generator-transformer-infinite-bus (SMIB) draft with subtransient reactance, step-up impedance, and damping load for AVR/PSS hardware-in-the-loop validation.
code:
CASE SyncMachine_SMIB_HIL
TIME_STEP 50e-6
FINISH_TIME 0.50
FREQUENCY 60
SUBSYSTEM 1
COMPONENT SOURCE GEN_EMF nodes=GEN_INT,0 V=16500
COMPONENT R R_STATOR nodes=GEN_INT,GEN_TERM R=0.08
COMPONENT L L_SUBTRANS nodes=GEN_TERM,GSU_LV L=0.0045
COMPONENT L L_GSU nodes=GSU_LV,HV_BUS L=0.018
COMPONENT C C_FILTER nodes=HV_BUS,0 C=4.0e-6
COMPONENT R R_CORRIDOR nodes=HV_BUS,INF_BUS R=1.5
COMPONENT L L_CORRIDOR nodes=HV_BUS,INF_BUS L=0.042
COMPONENT SOURCE GRID_INF nodes=INF_BUS,0 V=16500

title: Grid-Following PV Inverter with LCL Filter HIL Model
description: Small-time-step (25 us) RTDS power-electronics HIL model of a grid-following solar PV inverter coupled to a stiff 13.8 kV grid through a damped LCL harmonic filter.
code:
CASE GridFollowing_PV_LCL_HIL
TIME_STEP 25e-6
FINISH_TIME 0.20
FREQUENCY 60
SUBSYSTEM 1
COMPONENT SOURCE INV_BRIDGE nodes=INV_OUT,0 V=690
COMPONENT L L_INV nodes=INV_OUT,LCL_MID L=0.0008
COMPONENT R R_DAMP nodes=LCL_MID,CAP_N R=0.45
COMPONENT C C_LCL nodes=CAP_N,0 C=1.2e-4
COMPONENT L L_GRID nodes=LCL_MID,PCC_BUS L=0.0005
COMPONENT R R_PCC_LOAD nodes=PCC_BUS,0 R=24.0
COMPONENT R R_GRID_EQ nodes=PCC_BUS,GRID_SRC R=0.12
COMPONENT SOURCE GRID_13KV nodes=GRID_SRC,0 V=690

title: Hardware-in-the-Loop Relay Testing Microgrid Suite
description: Multi-file RTDS closed-loop relay testing benchmark pairing a multi-subsystem microgrid draft (grid tie, BESS inverter, diesel genset, critical load) with an automated fault-injection schedule CSV.
code:
CASE Microgrid_Relay_HIL
TIME_STEP 50e-6
FINISH_TIME 1.00
FREQUENCY 60
SUBSYSTEM 1
COMPONENT SOURCE UTIL_GRID nodes=UTIL_BUS,0 V=12470
COMPONENT R R_TIE nodes=UTIL_BUS,PCC_BUS R=0.45
COMPONENT L L_TIE nodes=PCC_BUS,MG_BUS L=0.0065
COMPONENT C C_MG_SHUNT nodes=MG_BUS,0 C=1.5e-5
COMPONENT R R_CRIT_LOAD nodes=MG_BUS,0 R=42.0
SUBSYSTEM 2
COMPONENT SOURCE BESS_GFM nodes=BESS_TERM,0 V=12470
COMPONENT L L_BESS nodes=BESS_TERM,MG_BUS L=0.0040
COMPONENT SOURCE DIESEL_GEN nodes=GEN_TERM,0 V=12470
COMPONENT R R_GEN nodes=GEN_TERM,MG_BUS R=0.35
